title: sSumoPvP
description: A lightweight and configurable SumoPvP plugin for Minecraft servers, featuring custom arenas, 1v1 fights, holograms, bossbars, protection systems, and staff-controlled events.
body:
# sSumoPvP

**sSumoPvP** is a Minecraft plugin that adds a simple and professional SumoPvP arena system for servers.

The plugin is made for **manual events**, **quick tournaments**, and **staff-controlled 1v1 SumoPvP fights**. It does not include ranked matches, ELO, or automatic matchmaking. Instead, it focuses on clean and controlled SumoPvP fights using configurable arenas.

---

## Features

* Arena creation using a selection wand
* Configurable SumoPvP arenas
* 1v1 fights controlled by staff
* Optional arena selection when starting a fight
* Dynamic holograms for arena information
* BossBar support during fights
* Automatic inventory, armor, and gamemode restoration
* Fight protection system
* PlaceholderAPI support
* Commands to create, edit, enable, disable, start, stop, and reload arenas

---

## Fight Protection

During a SumoPvP fight, the plugin helps keep the match clean by blocking things such as:

* Outside player interference
* Unwanted damage
* Fall damage
* Hunger loss
* Building
* Item drops
* Command usage during fights

This makes the plugin useful for organized events where staff members need full control over the match.

---

## Main Commands

| Command                                     | Description                       |
| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `/ssumo wand`                               | Gives the arena selection wand.   |
| `/ssumo create <arena>`                     | Creates a new arena.              |
| `/ssumo redefine <arena>`                   | Updates an arena selection.       |
| `/ssumo setspawn <arena> <1\|2>`            | Sets the player spawn points.     |
| `/ssumo setholo <arena>`                    | Places the arena hologram.        |
| `/ssumo settime <arena> <5m\|300s>`         | Sets the maximum fight time.      |
| `/ssumo enable <arena> <true\|false>`       | Enables or disables an arena.     |
| `/ssumo vs <player1> <player2> [arena]`     | Starts a SumoPvP fight.           |
| `/wsumo select <player1> <player2> [arena]` | Quick alias to start a fight.     |
| `/ssumo stop <arena\|player\|all>`          | Stops an active fight.            |
| `/ssumo leave`                              | Allows a player to surrender.     |
| `/ssumo reload`                             | Reloads the plugin configuration. |

---

## How to Set Up an Arena

1. Place the plugin `.jar` file inside your server’s `/plugins` folder.
2. Restart the server.
3. Use `/ssumo wand`.
4. Select the arena area.
5. Create the arena with `/ssumo create <name>`.
6. Set both spawns:

   * `/ssumo setspawn <arena> 1`
   * `/ssumo setspawn <arena> 2`
7. Place the hologram with `/ssumo setholo <arena>`.
8. Enable the arena.
9. Start a fight with `/ssumo vs <player1> <player2> [arena]`.

---

## Best Used For

* Survival events
* Practice servers
* Community tournaments
* BoxPvP servers
* HCF / Factions events
* Minigame servers
* Competitive Minecraft servers

---

## Support

If you find a bug or have a suggestion, you can report it through the official support Discord.

This plugin is focused on manual SumoPvP events and staff-controlled fights.
